messages.text:
Good morning,
I am requesting an update regarding two outstanding orders:

   -
Order #····-A – Placed July 31

   -
Order #····-A – Placed September 27

I initially contacted Heliumdeploy on October 31 to request an update on the expected shipping dates for both orders. Since then, I have followed up multiple times ((address hidden), November 4, and November 9), yet I have received only automated responses indicating that the matter has been escalated to the team. To date, I have not received an actual status update, estimated shipping date, or explanation for the delays.

Given the significant amount of time these orders have been outstanding, the lack of communication and continued uncertainty regarding fulfillment are concerning.

I would appreciate the following:

   -
Confirmation of the current status of each order.

   -
A specific and reliable estimated shipping date for each order.

   -
An explanation for the delays and whether there are any outstanding fulfillment or inventory issues.

   -
If shipment cannot occur promptly, an explanation of the available options for resolution.

I have been patient and have made several attempts to obtain this information. At this point, I am looking for a direct response with clear timelines rather than another acknowledgment that the request has been forwarded internally.

Thank you for your prompt attention. I look forward to receiving a substantive update.

Best regards,

Tim L.

Thanks again for your patience, Tim.

Sarah
